# rustops

> Early-stage AIOps toolkit in Rust: Z-score/IQR anomaly detection, alert correlation, event-sourced incidents, Prometheus pipeline.

rustops is maintained by marcuspat (Agentic Engineer — Platform Engineering × AI-assisted development).
